rationale: Recent tail curriculum variants were too disruptive, but the best path still points to staged reverse-tail recurrence. This edit keeps the winning 9x512 recurrent-tail family intact while splitting each recurrent step into an earlier anchor-carry phase and a later heavier block-replay phase. Carry gains ramp with a softer exponent and block gains ramp with a steeper exponent, so the model can learn to refresh from the decoder-output anchor before paying the full recurrent transform cost. That is a compact, compile-stable structural change aimed directly at the strongest remaining local signal: recurrence scheduling on the reverse-tail path, not another scalar sweep.
title: Asymmetric Reverse-Tail Recurrence Curriculum
